verdict.rationale: Polar is a SaaS billing platform that stores customer and usage data, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair privacy question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions an AI-training data policy or an opt-out control. The MCP, sandbox and usage-billing items are about other capabilities and do not address training-data use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
